chose: While our judgment about hardware, and the software infrastructure around it (machines, GPUs, hosting, the services that run on them), is naive, nothing in that domain is paid for: no rental, no purchase, no paid tier. Every step there that costs money comes last in its story and is gated behind a measured judgment gate: the owner's own predictions, made before seeing results, hold against real measurements. Defining that measure and recognising when it is met is part of the story (#3309). Spending outside that domain is not covered.
